data.description:
### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** $(git rev-parse HEAD)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Sub-Agent Blocker

#### Expected Behavior

The calibration-rollup.yml workflow should record real mutation findings counts and test churn counts per push, injected from upstream mutation-testing and churn-analysis CI steps.

#### Actual Behavior

MUTATION_FINDINGS_COUNT and SUITE_CHURN_COUNT env vars are declared as interface inputs in the workflow but no upstream CI step populates them. The :-0 fallback always activates, recording zero for both values on every push to main. A comment referencing this bug was added to the workflow as a placeholder.
data.title: [calibration-rollup.yml]: MUTATION_FINDINGS_COUNT and SUITE_CHURN_COUNT not injected -> always records 0
